body: Follow-up to the gated RL casting change, same thread ('how do we combine heuristics with the ml model so we do a little fuzzy best of both worlds'). New rl_engage_confidence() scales the movement nudge by how many other living combatants are near the fight -- a clean 1v1 keeps full nudge strength, a chaotic teamfight the model never trained on (strictly 1v1 training, no teammates/other enemies ever) gets heavily damped instead of a hard on/off rule. Full suite green.
title: feat: confidence-weighted RL engagement nudge
